## MCP - OAuth Get

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/oauth-get

### Input
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "chess_plugin",
  "user_id": "discord_123456",
  "provider": "lichess"
}
```

### Output (token existe)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "has_token": true,
  "provider": "lichess",
  "access_token": "lip_xxxx",
  "refresh_token": "lrt_xxxx",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-12T14:00:00+00:00",
  "is_expired": false,
  "scope": "challenge:read challenge:write",
  "provider_user_id": "DrNykterstein"
}
```

### Output (pas de token)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "has_token": false,
  "provider": "lichess",
  "message": "Aucun token OAuth..."
}
```

### Securite
Les tokens sont dechiffres a la volee
(AES-256-GCM cote backend).

### RFC-039 compliant
